headline: The booth learns to hold paper
lede: Papers, Please-MIN got its signature verb: press-drag grabs a document, carries it tilted across the counter, and sets it down where you release — booth-side paint only, fairness prover untouched, 61/61 mutants die, 132/132 live mouse gates.

notes.text: #2120 Papers in hand shipped (1bef805): grab/carry/land on the passport and ID card, desk clamp can never lose a paper or blindfold the entrant; tap-to-stamp, phone pad and the photo-hold zoom survive byte-for-byte.
Seed 0's first walk-up is the no-papers customer — live gates that grab documents must seat a carrying entrant first (stamp correct verdicts with real keys, then wait for the drop to settle).
Prod verify runs through apex->www redirects and Vercel ships union builds: chunk names differ from local dist, so grep the live chunk for the new constant instead of comparing hashes.
Exact-equality compares on CSS->canvas coords flake at 1e-5 (89.99999 vs 90) — round landed offsets before asserting.
